description: Calibration set for the evidence cut-off (FAST_MIN_EVIDENCE_SCORE). The cut-off is a weak out-of-domain gate on the reranker score, not calibrated confidence. 'answerable' questions come from the eval set; 'near_domain_unsupported' share vocabulary with the corpus but their answer is absent (each new one verified absent by keyword search over all chunks when the file was created); 'out_of_domain' are unrelated to the corpus.
